module: Third-party library lua-resty-template: engine micro-benchmark (parse, compile and execution time of a small template in a loop). Development tool of the library, of no use to a modder.
notes: Bug: the last loop of `run` references the tables `views` and `contexts`, which are declared nowhere in the file (nil globals); the call crashes at the "Execution Time" measurement.
Prints via print (or ngx.say); clears `template.cache` during the compilation measurement.

run.desc: Runs the benchmark: measures `parse`, `compile` and template execution over `iterations` loops and prints the times (os.clock).
